mission: Explore an unresolved physical or chemical possibility using broad measurements, independent controls, and claim ceilings. The player is not told whether the hidden starting state is instrumental, abiotic, prebiotic, biological, novel physics, or ultimately unresolved.

evidence_ladder.name: No candidate
evidence_ladder.claim_ceiling: No unusual life-related claim is supported.

evidence_ladder.name: Unusual pattern
evidence_ladder.claim_ceiling: An unusual physical or chemical pattern is present.

evidence_ladder.name: Repeatable pattern
evidence_ladder.claim_ceiling: The pattern repeats under recorded conditions.

evidence_ladder.name: Organized process
evidence_ladder.claim_ceiling: Energy, chemistry, or structure shows persistent organization.

evidence_ladder.name: Life-like system
evidence_ladder.claim_ceiling: Multiple life-like properties are present, but abiotic origins remain viable.

evidence_ladder.name: Abiotic alternatives constrained
evidence_ladder.claim_ceiling: Known abiotic and instrumental explanations are substantially constrained.

evidence_ladder.name: Candidate living system
evidence_ladder.claim_ceiling: A living-system interpretation is scientifically plausible and requires independent confirmation.

evidence_ladder.name: External biology strongly supported
evidence_ladder.claim_ceiling: Convergent, independent evidence strongly supports biology; governance and external review remain required.

available_actions.name: Run a broad-spectrum survey
available_actions.description: Look for unusual structure without assuming a particular chemistry or organism.

available_actions.name: Repeat from a changed geometry
available_actions.description: Test whether the pattern survives orbital phase, pointing, and viewing-angle changes.

available_actions.name: Use an independent instrument family
available_actions.description: Check the candidate with different hardware and processing assumptions.

available_actions.name: Measure molecular diversity and complexity
available_actions.description: Test statistical organization rather than searching only for Earth-specific molecules.

available_actions.name: Map persistent energy-transfer gradients
available_actions.description: Look for maintained redox, electrochemical, or thermal organization.

available_actions.name: Search for bounded compartments
available_actions.description: Search for repeated bounded regions that concentrate selected elements or molecules.

available_actions.name: Apply a reversible environmental perturbation
available_actions.description: Test whether the system shows retained, context-dependent response without assuming intent.

available_actions.name: Run abiotic and instrumental controls
available_actions.description: Attempt to reproduce the signal through known physics, chemistry, contamination, and processing artifacts.

available_actions.name: Commission a blind independent reanalysis
available_actions.description: Give another analysis seat the raw data without the favored hypothesis.

available_actions.name: Archive the candidate and continue exploring
available_actions.description: Preserve all evidence without forcing a conclusion.

initial_state.claim_ceiling: No unusual life-related claim is supported.

truth_boundary: An unusual observation is not automatically an anomaly.
An anomaly is not automatically life or new physics.
Life-like organization is not automatically a living system.
A null result constrains only the tested channel and sensitivity.
The player may finish without learning the private origin class.
